pdfSnapshot.familiesInTheAlderCreek: Families in the Alder Creek valley travel an average of 46 miles to reach a primary care provider, and one in four households has no reliable vehicle. Over the last three years our intake data shows that missed appointments, not lack of coverage, is the leading reason children in our programs fall behind on well-child visits and immunizations.
pdfSnapshot.mobileHealthNavigationPairsA: Mobile Health Navigation pairs a community health navigator with a scheduled van route across the six unincorporated communities we serve. Navigators schedule visits, arrange rides, and follow up on referrals so that a family's first contact with the clinic is not an emergency room visit. The 2026 county health assessment ranks transportation access as the top barrier to care for rural families, and our pilot with 38 families cut missed appointments by 41 percent. Source: answer library “Need”, edited
pdfSnapshot.twoNavigatorsCoverAWeekly: Two navigators cover a weekly route of six stops. Each stop offers scheduling, transport vouchers, and warm hand-offs to the Copper Valley Clinic telehealth room.
